record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale chronological positional embeddings by 0.95 instead of 1.0 in both training and prediction. Since both 0.75 and 1.15 regressed, test a smaller reduction that mildly softens positional influence while retaining order information. Preserve position IDs, history truncation, exclusive-mask training, appended-mask final-position readout, backbone, item embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer.
